body:
Adds `research/thermal-twin`: a motor holding a load heats and loses torque constant; the constant-gain twin certifies every load, while the real hold has a fold at λ=4/27, no hold above it, and finite runaway time. Short tests cannot see it; refitting a constant gain does not remove the fold. Includes tests (8), reproducible experiments, whitepaper, README bullet and site entry; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
